name: The Inn at Little Washington
changeNote: Dropped from three stars to two
dinnerNote: Tasting menu, plus tax and an automatic service charge (no tipping expected)

menus.name: Tasting menu
menus.note: Plus tax and service charge; a $100 per person deposit when you book

menus.name: Caviar Tasting Menu
menus.note: Eight to ten courses built around caviar; prepaid, for 1 to 6

alsoTry.name: Patty O's Café
alsoTry.note: The Inn's casual restaurant across the street, open for lunch and dinner, including Mondays and Tuesdays when the main dining room is closed

dressCode: No formal dress code (as chef Patrick O'Connell says, "anything but a wet bikini"); most guests wear cocktail attire.
bookingOpens: Online on Tock, for 1 to 8, with a $100 per person deposit. The dining room is closed on Mondays and Tuesdays. Thanksgiving, Christmas and New Year's Eve have their own prepaid menus ($474 to $976).
groups: For 5 or more, book through the reservations department (reservations@theinnatlittlewashington.com), as only a few tables seat larger groups.
